collections.name: Active flagship program
collections.role: Current hypotheses, preregistrations, budgets, data contracts, and launch gates

collections.name: Reusable architecture-promotion protocol
collections.role: Reusable statistical, evaluation, and cost-governance contracts

collections.name: Retired Paper 1 program
collections.role: Retired preregistrations and source audits retained for provenance

collections.name: Research notebook
collections.role: Chronological context, attempts, discussions, open questions, and handoffs

collections.name: External literature notes
collections.role: Versioned summaries of claims made by other researchers

collections.name: Speck findings
collections.role: Distilled Speck conclusions, limitations, and decisions linked to evidence

collections.name: Experiment configurations
collections.role: Immutable runnable or historical model, data, training, and evaluation inputs

collections.name: Checked result records
collections.role: Append-only machine-readable summaries and bounded audit evidence

collections.name: Flagship manuscript workspace
collections.role: Claim registry, manuscript source, generated figures, tables, and references

collections.name: Research software
collections.role: Model, data, training, evaluation, analysis, and provenance implementation

systems.name: Git repository
systems.location: repository checkout and remote Git host
systems.role: Code, contracts, small results, findings, notebook, claims, and paper source
systems.authority: Canonical text and small machine-readable record

systems.name: Speck runtime artifact store
systems.role: Datasets, checkpoints, full logs, predictions, traces, exports, and temporary files
systems.authority: Artifact bytes only when identified by a checked manifest and digest

systems.name: Weights & Biases
systems.location: remote service plus ignored local wandb directory
systems.role: Live metrics, charts, and operational monitoring
systems.authority: Convenience mirror; never the sole scientific record

systems.name: Linear
systems.role: Work queue, ownership, dependencies, and status communication
systems.authority: Operational state; never the sole scientific record

systems.name: Publication archive
systems.location: Hugging Face and a DOI-minting repository selected before release
systems.role: Public models, data metadata, code snapshot, paper, and research compendium
systems.authority: Immutable release snapshot after publication audit

lifecycle.name: Question and context
lifecycle.exit_gate: The uncertainty and its relevance to the flagship are explicit

lifecycle.name: Literature and prior evidence
lifecycle.record: Versioned paper notes and prior Speck findings
lifecycle.exit_gate: Claims, versions, limitations, and overlap are separated from Speck evidence

lifecycle.name: Preregistration
lifecycle.exit_gate: Controls, seeds, metrics, stopping, decision rule, budget, and fallbacks are frozen

lifecycle.name: Implementation qualification
lifecycle.record: Code, tests, reference parity, and hardware preflight
lifecycle.exit_gate: Correctness is separated from quality and production performance

lifecycle.name: Execution
lifecycle.record: Immutable run manifest plus external raw artifacts
lifecycle.exit_gate: Code, data, model, environment, hardware, seeds, and outputs are identified

lifecycle.name: Analysis
lifecycle.record: Append-only result JSON generated by frozen analysis code
lifecycle.exit_gate: All arms, seeds, failures, uncertainty, and preregistered guardrails are reported

lifecycle.name: Finding and decision
lifecycle.record: Finding linked to contracts and machine-readable results
lifecycle.exit_gate: Conclusion, limitations, failed gates, and next decision are explicit

lifecycle.name: Paper claim
lifecycle.record: Claim-registry status and generated figure/table sources
lifecycle.exit_gate: The claim is no broader than its evidence and every number is traceable

lifecycle.name: Archival release
lifecycle.record: Model card, code snapshot, manifests, paper, and DOI/archive identities
lifecycle.exit_gate: An independent reader can inspect and reproduce the supported results
